title: image: accept URL keys listed by credential helpers
body:
Fixes https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/30058

## Problem
- On macOS, setting credential-helpers = ["osxkeychain"] in registries.conf makes every pull fail, including public images.
- docker-credential-osxkeychain always saves and lists keys as https://<host>.
- GetAllCredentials adds keys from external helpers without changing them, and validateKey rejects anything starting with http[s]://.
- podman-remote sends all saved logins with each pull, so one such key breaks every pull.

## Fix
- Keys listed by external helpers are now resolved by host.
- Only keys with http:// or https:// change; plain host-name keys behave as before.

## Testing
- Added case to TestGetAllCredentials with fake helper that lists URL keys.
- Checked against docker-credential-osxkeychain: after the fix it returns example.test.
